title: Grateful Dead Live at Lanai Theater on 1969-11-15
lineage: SBD cassette master > PCM > CDR > iMac > SHN > shntool > SHN

ai_review.summary: Quiet, muddy soundboard capture of a fairly sloppy 1969 show—historically interesting but not sonically pristine.
ai_review.review: The recording is a classic 1969 sound‑board tape that, while valuable as a historical document, suffers from low volume, feedback and muddiness. The performance itself is described as uneven and somewhat sloppy, offering few standout moments beyond its vintage charm. Listeners who appreciate the era may find it worthwhile, but audiophiles looking for clarity will be disappointed.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews show mixed opinions (one very positive about historical value, two noting poor sound and sloppy performance). The average star rating is ~3.7, leading to a combined rating around 3.8 with medium confidence due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very quiet overall level, noticeable feedback issues and muddy sound, though some reviewers note it sounds decent for a 1969 tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or pacing.
